Re: Claim C-1259
Our client: Denise Turner
Date of loss: 7-3-23
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in your file. Please direct all further
communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in
person. Our client was struck in a head-on impact that, while occurring at low speed, has resulted in ongoing physical symptoms
requiring medical evaluation and treatment.
We request that you provide a complete statement of the policy limits applicable to the insured driver, including any excess or
umbrella coverage that may apply, together with a copy of the declarations page. Please confirm in writing that your insured's
policy information has been disclsoed in full.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder
information, photographs, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please take
steps to ensrue none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired before it can be properly inspected. We look forward to your
prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
